title: Add Sales Order shipment and finance progress report
description: Add a read-only Sales Order progress report that summarizes shipment quantities and finance linkage from existing authoritative order, stock-out/movement and reconciliation records. Do not infer document links from free text, create receivable records, add production schema, or mutate order, inventory or finance data.
acceptance_criteria: The report exposes ordered, authoritatively shipped and outstanding quantities for Sales Orders where persisted references support the calculation.
Linked finance amount, document/reference number, status and date reuse the existing reconciliation rules rather than introducing a second matching algorithm.
Missing shipment or finance linkage is displayed explicitly as unknown or unlinked and is not treated as zero or fully outstanding without supporting evidence.
Users can filter by customer, order date, shipment status and finance-link status, and different currencies are never aggregated into one monetary total.
Queries are bounded or paged and avoid per-order database queries for normal report use.
Unit/integration tests cover unshipped, partially shipped, fully shipped, linked finance and unknown-linkage histories; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open the Sales Order progress report and inspect an order with partial authoritative shipment history.
Inspect orders with linked and unavailable finance references and verify the statuses are distinguished clearly.

human_gate.reason: Read-only report over existing order, inventory and finance references; no receivable creation, production mutation, deployment or release.
